body:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx and elevated latency observed for hosted-api in us-east-1 and multiple Dedicated pools in the same region. Trigger: router error rate > 5% for last 2m. Pager duty: on-call anne paged.

anne (oncall): saw the alert, coming in. first check — running quick curl against health endpoints.

ben (sre): I’m on it — can everyone avoid large config changes for now. heads-up: token refresh failures in logs pointing at sts.amazonaws.com timeouts.

maria (eng-runtime): confirming KV cache hit-rates are normal; this looks external. throwing the AWS status link here: <https://status.aws.amazon.com|AWS SHD> — there’s an ongoing issue in us-east-1 listing IAM/STS throttling in the incident feed.

jason (support): any idea which customers are impacted? we’ve got two support tickets from AcmeCorp complaining 502s for autocomplete. priority up.

ben (sre): quick numbers from metrics: hosted-api 5xx rate ~8% overall in us-east-1, Dedicated pool dp-42 showing 22% 5xx for requests that require token exchange. fallback pools in other regions still nominal.

anne (oncall): creating incident bridge and escalating to SEV-2. @ryan can you open a cross-team bridge?

ryan (eng-platform): bridge up: https://meet.redwood/incident/1794200893 — joining. I’ll spin up a traffic-routing task to shift regional traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback not applicable. Automatic routing policy engaged: failover to eu-west-1 for non-stateful traffic.

ben (sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) Reduce token exchanges by using cached tokens where safe (10m TTL). 2) Route new non-auth critical requests away from us-east-1 via smart-router config. 3) For Dedicated customers: trigger emergency capacity in other regions and enable fallback mode (best-effort routing). 4) Increase client-side retry/backoff for STS calls.

maria (eng-runtime): patch ready to enable token cache toggle in runtime — small flag flip. dropping code snippet for enabling (applied to hosted and dedicated control-plane):

```bash
# flip flag to enable cached-sts-tokens for 10m TTL
redwoodctl config set runtime.cached_sts_tokens true --ttl 600 --scope region:us-east-1
```

ben (sre): executing now. monitoring logs for immediate change.

anne (oncall): @jason please prepare a customer-facing note summarizing: cause pending (AWS STS region issue), current mitigations (routing + token caching), ETA unknown, recommend pointing customers to we’ll follow up.

jason (support): on it. draft ETA: unknown; initial impact window since 12:34 UTC. will queue outbound to affected customers (AcmeCorp, Brightline, FinNova) and mark for priority.

ben (sre): logs after cache flip: reduced STS call rate by ~65% for hosted-api control plane, 5xx down from 8% -> 3.2% in 6m. Dedicated dp-42 still at 12% for high-auth flows; looks like some pools still doing immediate token exchanges.

maria (eng-runtime): pushing a strategy to Dedicated oncall: add configuration to pin dp-42 to use cached tokens and enable fallback to model-compact variant for clients with high error rates.

anne (oncall): handing off to ben for operational tracking — I have to run an unrelated oncall rotation meeting. ben will be primary until further notice. taking ownership for post-incident writeup later. :thumbsup:

ben (sre): I’m primary. assigning tasks: @maria config + rollout, @ryan routing changes + capacity in eu-west-1, @jason customer comms. Will update every 15m or on major change.

deploy-bot: Routing config change applied: all non-auth read-only endpoints now prefer eu-west-1 with failover to eu-west-2.

maria (eng-runtime): Dedicated dp-42 config pushed, enabling cached tokens and fallback model. sample command used:

```json
{ "pool": "dp-42", "settings": { "cached_sts_tokens": true, "model_fallback": "compact-v2" } }
```

ben (sre): monitoring shows dp-42 5xx fell: 12% -> 6% after config, and user-visible errors for AcmeCorp down from 32% -> 10% over last 10m. slow but trending to normal.

jason (support): outbound note sent to affected customers. copy: "We're seeing elevated errors due to AWS IAM/STS issues in us-east-1. We've implemented token caching and regional failover; you may see degraded latency for some requests routed to fallback regions. We're monitoring and will update."

anne (oncall): FYI ops checklist: 1) track AWS SHD updates; 2) preserve logs for RCA; 3) measure any regression after we revert caching; 4) notify sales for enterprise customers who may escalate.

ben (sre): AWS has posted a mitigation message about partial STS degradation in us-east-1 ~ 12:22 UTC. monitoring their updates.

ryan (eng-platform): spun up two extra Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and eu-west-2 for critical customers. provisioning took ~8m, attaching now. runbook command used: `infractl pool create --region eu-west-1 --type dedicated --size s-2x`

maria (eng-runtime): runtime metrics: prefix caching + reduced STS calls are dropping p99 latency by ~60ms on hosted traffic. good sign.

ben (sre): current status at 30m: hosted-api 5xx stabilized at 2.5% (target <1%), Dedicated impacted pools down to 4-6% depending on workload. continuing to watch.

jason (support): support queues trending down. no new high-sev tickets in last 18m.

anne (oncall): I’m back and saw the updates, nice work. running a quick check — are we seeing any observability bleed (Datadog/OTel) missing spans?

maria (eng-runtime): partial metric ingestion gaps noted for traces in us-east-1 (CloudWatch -> OTel pipeline). we are routing traces to secondary ingestion temporarily. that’s low priority for customer impact but tracked.

ben (sre): plan for next hour: 1) keep routing failover in place until AWS marks STS fully recovered + 60m stable. 2) Keep token cache enabled for affected regions. 3) Schedule post-mortem and RCA owners.

anne (oncall): assigning RCA owner: @maria will lead runtime investigation (root cause + mitigation effectiveness). ben will lead operational timeline and mitigation log. jason will collate customer impact timeline.

ben (sre): final quick note: if anyone sees new stubborn 5xx patterns, add logs with `req_id` and tag `incident:1794200893`; that makes search and correlation immediate.

jason (support): tagged historical tickets and added incident reference.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, partial recovery observed. Next update in 15m or on status change.

anne (oncall): thanks all. we’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth for the timeline. I’ll draft the initial incident summary after we go to stable.

ben (sre): 60m post-mitigation update: metrics show near-complete recovery for hosted; Dedicated pools fully recovered after regional reattachment and config. closing the active pager at this time, moving to RCA and postmortem phase.

maria (eng-runtime): will start the postmortem doc and link it here when ready. preliminary actions for follow-up: 1) permanent cached token toggle if beneficial, 2) improve routing failover automation, 3) add STS dependency health checks to oncall runbooks.

jason (support): customer follow-ups queued. closing customer-facing incident messages for now, will update if AWS reopens issue.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause pending (AWS us-east-1 STS/ IAM partial outage). Actions: routing failovers, token caching, extra capacity. Postmortem planned.
